title: Two routes of one verb that write the same template.
text: `/files/{path}` beside `/files/{path...}`, `/a` beside `/a/{x?}`, and `/a/{id}` beside `/a/{key}` each write one path key, and the emitter's `or_insert_with` keeps the first row. OpenAPI 3.1 also forbids two templated paths that differ only in their capture names. Whether the router admits such a pair decides whether `nvs build --openapi` needs a diagnostic for it.
